# Analysis code

This script describes model development and validation in the overall cohort (n = 267) and the primary cohort without radiological lymph node enlargement (n = 246). It expects a preselected dataset of eligible patients using the standard variable names below. Individual patient data are not shared. Set `PRIMARY_COHORT` to `TRUE` or `FALSE` to analyze either cohort.

The workflow covers multiple imputation, LASSO regression, bootstrap internal validation, and figures. The code is shared for methodological transparency; numerical results cannot be reproduced without the restricted dataset.

# Analysis settings

```{r settings}
# Input: one row per eligible patient in the overall cohort (n = 267).
# No patient-level data or source-system column names are distributed.
DATA_FILE <- file.path("data", "analysis_dataset.csv")
PRIMARY_COHORT <- TRUE  # TRUE: 246 patients; FALSE: all 267 patients

# Required columns and coding:
# lnm: pathological LNM (0/1)
# age (years), bmi (kg/m^2), tumor_volume_index (cm^3), ca125, ca19_9,
# albumin_globulin_ratio, crp: continuous
# deep_myometrial_invasion, cervical_stromal_invasion,
# extrauterine_extension, radiologic_ln_enlargement: imaging (0/1)
# preop_histology: endometrioid carcinoma grades 1–3 (EMG1–EMG3),
# and other high-grade histologies (Other)
# molecular_subtype: 1=p53-abnormal, 2=NSMP, 3=MSI-H, 4=POLE-mutated
REQUIRED_COLUMNS <- c(
  "lnm", "age", "bmi", "deep_myometrial_invasion", "tumor_volume_index",
  "ca125", "ca19_9", "albumin_globulin_ratio", "crp",
  "molecular_subtype", "preop_histology", "cervical_stromal_invasion",
  "extrauterine_extension", "radiologic_ln_enlargement"
)

M_IMP <- 20
MAXIT <- 10
NFOLDS_CV <- 10
SELECT_FREQ_THRESHOLD <- 0.40
B <- 200
M_BOOT <- M_IMP
MAXIT_BOOT <- MAXIT
SEED <- 2026
OUTPUT_DIR <- if (PRIMARY_COHORT) "output_primary" else "output_overall"
FIG_DPI <- 600
dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

# Data and cohort

```{r load-data}
if (!file.exists(DATA_FILE)) {
  stop("Standardized analysis file is unavailable: ", DATA_FILE,
       ". See the required variable definitions in the Settings section.")
}
raw <- utils::read.csv(DATA_FILE, na.strings = c("", "NA"),
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
absent <- setdiff(REQUIRED_COLUMNS, names(raw))
if (length(absent) > 0) {
  stop("Required standardized columns are missing: ",
       paste(absent, collapse = ", "))
}
dat <- raw[, REQUIRED_COLUMNS, drop = FALSE]
```

```{r preprocess}
outcome_var <- "lnm"
numeric_vars <- c("age", "bmi", "tumor_volume_index", "ca125", "ca19_9",
                  "albumin_globulin_ratio", "crp")
for (v in numeric_vars) dat[[v]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(dat[[v]]))
dat$lnm <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(dat$lnm)))

binary_vars <- c("deep_myometrial_invasion", "cervical_stromal_invasion",
                 "extrauterine_extension", "radiologic_ln_enlargement")
for (v in binary_vars) {
  values <- as.character(dat[[v]])
  if (any(!is.na(values) & !(values %in% c("0", "1")))) stop("Invalid binary coding: ", v)
  dat[[v]] <- factor(values, levels = c("0", "1"))
}

if (anyNA(dat$lnm) || any(!(dat$lnm %in% c(0, 1))))
  stop("The eligible cohort must have observed binary pathological LNM outcomes.")
if (anyNA(dat$radiologic_ln_enlargement))
  stop("Radiological lymph node enlargement must be known for cohort assignment.")

hist <- trimws(as.character(dat$preop_histology))
if (anyNA(hist) || any(!(hist %in% c("EMG1", "EMG2", "EMG3", "Other"))))
  stop("Invalid or missing preoperative histology category.")
dat$histology_group <- factor(hist, levels = c("EMG1", "EMG2", "EMG3", "Other"))
subtype <- as.character(dat$molecular_subtype)
if (anyNA(subtype) || any(!(subtype %in% c("1", "2", "3", "4"))))
  stop("Invalid or missing molecular subtype category.")
dat$molecular_subtype <- factor(subtype, levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4"))

if (PRIMARY_COHORT) {
  dat <- dat[dat$radiologic_ln_enlargement == "0", , drop = FALSE]
} else {
  stopifnot(all(!is.na(dat$radiologic_ln_enlargement)))
}
INCLUDE_RADIOLOGIC_LN_AS_VAR <- !PRIMARY_COHORT
if (PRIMARY_COHORT) dat$radiologic_ln_enlargement <- NULL
dat$preop_histology <- NULL

cat(sprintf("Cohort: %d patients (%d LNM-positive).\n", nrow(dat), sum(dat$lnm == 1)))
```

# Multiple imputation

```{r mice-impute}
base_vars <- c("age", "bmi", "deep_myometrial_invasion", "tumor_volume_index",
               "ca125", "ca19_9", "albumin_globulin_ratio", "crp",
               "histology_group", "molecular_subtype",
               "cervical_stromal_invasion", "extrauterine_extension")
if (INCLUDE_RADIOLOGIC_LN_AS_VAR) base_vars <- c(base_vars, "radiologic_ln_enlargement")

constant_vars <- base_vars[sapply(base_vars, function(v) length(unique(na.omit(dat[[v]]))) <= 1)]
if (length(constant_vars) > 0) {
  warning("Constant predictors: ", paste(constant_vars, collapse = ", "))
}

df_impute <- dat %>% dplyr::select(all_of(union(base_vars, outcome_var)))

meth <- mice::make.method(df_impute)
meth[outcome_var] <- ""   # outcome is not imputed
pred <- mice::make.predictorMatrix(df_impute)

imp <- mice::mice(df_impute, m = M_IMP, method = meth, predictorMatrix = pred,
                  maxit = MAXIT, seed = SEED, printFlag = FALSE)

write.csv(data.frame(predictor = names(df_impute),
                     missing = colSums(is.na(df_impute))),
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "missingness.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r derive-vars}
# log2(volume index + 1) is derived after imputation in every imputed dataset.
add_log_volume <- function(d) {
  d %>% dplyr::mutate(tumor_volume_index_log2 = ifelse(
    !is.na(tumor_volume_index) & tumor_volume_index >= 0,
    log2(tumor_volume_index + 1), NA_real_))
}

imp2 <- mice::as.mids(add_log_volume(mice::complete(imp, action = "long", include = TRUE)))
```

# Model development (LASSO)

```{r lasso}
lasso_vars <- c("age", "bmi", "deep_myometrial_invasion", "tumor_volume_index_log2",
                "ca125", "ca19_9", "albumin_globulin_ratio", "crp",
                "histology_group", "molecular_subtype",
                "cervical_stromal_invasion", "extrauterine_extension")
if (INCLUDE_RADIOLOGIC_LN_AS_VAR) lasso_vars <- c(lasso_vars, "radiologic_ln_enlargement")

d1 <- mice::complete(imp2, action = 1)
n_levels <- sapply(lasso_vars, function(v) length(unique(na.omit(d1[[v]]))))
lasso_vars_use <- lasso_vars[n_levels > 1]

# Design matrix (rows with any missing candidate predictor are dropped)
build_xy <- function(d) {
  d_sub <- d %>% dplyr::select(all_of(c(outcome_var, lasso_vars_use)))
  ok    <- stats::complete.cases(d_sub)
  d_sub <- d_sub[ok, , drop = FALSE]
  y <- as.numeric(as.character(d_sub[[outcome_var]]))
  X <- model.matrix(as.formula(paste("~", paste(lasso_vars_use, collapse = " + "))),
                    data = d_sub)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  list(X = X, y = y, rows_kept = which(ok))
}

# Predicted probability from a coefficient vector (same length as nrow(d))
predict_penalized <- function(d, coef_vec) {
  xy   <- build_xy(d)
  beta <- coef_vec[colnames(xy$X)]
  beta[is.na(beta)] <- 0
  lp   <- coef_vec["(Intercept)"] + as.numeric(xy$X %*% beta)
  p    <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(d))
  p[xy$rows_kept] <- 1 / (1 + exp(-lp))
  p
}

lasso_coefs_list <- vector("list", M_IMP)
lambda_min_list  <- numeric(M_IMP)

for (i in seq_len(M_IMP)) {
  xy <- build_xy(mice::complete(imp2, action = i))
  set.seed(SEED + i)
  cvfit <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(xy$X, xy$y, family = "binomial", alpha = 1, nfolds = NFOLDS_CV)
  lasso_coefs_list[[i]] <- as.matrix(coef(cvfit, s = "lambda.min"))[, 1]
  lambda_min_list[i]    <- cvfit$lambda.min
}

all_terms <- Reduce(union, lapply(lasso_coefs_list, names))
coef_mat  <- do.call(cbind, lapply(lasso_coefs_list, function(v) v[all_terms]))
coef_mat  <- as.matrix(coef_mat)
rownames(coef_mat) <- all_terms

final_coef     <- rowMeans(coef_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
selection_freq <- rowMeans(coef_mat != 0, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r select-stable-vars}
# Map each model term (e.g. "histology_groupEMG2") to its source variable
term_to_base <- function(term, vars) {
  vv  <- vars[order(-nchar(vars))]
  hit <- vv[startsWith(term, vv)]
  if (length(hit) == 0) NA_character_ else hit[1]
}

# Variable-level selection frequency: any dummy of the variable non-zero
var_level_freq <- sapply(lasso_vars_use, function(v) {
  terms_v <- all_terms[sapply(all_terms, term_to_base, vars = lasso_vars_use) == v]
  terms_v <- intersect(terms_v, rownames(coef_mat))
  if (length(terms_v) == 0) return(0)
  mean(apply(coef_mat[terms_v, , drop = FALSE] != 0, 2, any, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE)
})

selected_base_vars <- names(var_level_freq)[var_level_freq >= SELECT_FREQ_THRESHOLD]
write.csv(data.frame(predictor = names(var_level_freq),
                     selected_datasets = as.integer(round(M_IMP * var_level_freq)),
                     selection_frequency = as.numeric(var_level_freq),
                     retained = names(var_level_freq) %in% selected_base_vars),
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "selection_frequency.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

kept_terms <- c("(Intercept)",
                all_terms[sapply(all_terms, term_to_base, vars = lasso_vars_use) %in%
                            selected_base_vars])
kept_terms <- intersect(kept_terms, names(final_coef))

final_coef_simplified <- final_coef
final_coef_simplified[setdiff(names(final_coef), kept_terms)] <- 0

# Tables
coef_table <- data.frame(
  term                      = names(final_coef),
  mean_penalized_coef       = final_coef,
  term_selection_frequency  = selection_freq,
  coef_final_model          = final_coef_simplified,
  row.names = NULL
)
write.csv(coef_table, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "model_coefficients.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("Retained predictors: %s\n", paste(selected_base_vars, collapse = ", ")))
```

## Model object for the nomogram

`rms::nomogram()` cannot take a glmnet object, so an `lrm` object with the same terms is fitted
for its structure only and its coefficients are replaced by the pooled penalized coefficients.
Predictions are checked for numerical agreement.

```{r nomogram-model}
nomo_vars    <- if (length(selected_base_vars) > 0) selected_base_vars else lasso_vars_use
dat_for_nomo <- mice::complete(imp2, action = 1)

dd <- rms::datadist(dat_for_nomo)
old_datadist <- getOption("datadist")
options(datadist = "dd")

fit_lrm0 <- rms::lrm(as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", paste(nomo_vars, collapse = " + "))),
                     data = dat_for_nomo, x = TRUE, y = TRUE)

normalize_name <- function(x) gsub("[=()]", "", x)
matched_idx <- match(normalize_name(names(coef(fit_lrm0))), normalize_name(names(final_coef)))
if (any(is.na(matched_idx))) stop("lrm terms could not be matched to penalized coefficients")

fit_nomo <- fit_lrm0
fit_nomo$coefficients <- setNames(final_coef_simplified[matched_idx], names(coef(fit_lrm0)))

dat_verify <- dat_for_nomo[stats::complete.cases(dat_for_nomo[, lasso_vars_use, drop = FALSE]), ]
max_diff <- max(abs(predict_penalized(dat_verify, final_coef_simplified) -
                    as.numeric(predict(fit_nomo, newdata = dat_verify, type = "fitted"))))
cat(sprintf("Maximum difference, penalized vs nomogram model predictions: %.2e\n", max_diff))
stopifnot(max_diff < 1e-8)

options(datadist = old_datadist)
```

# Apparent performance

```{r perf-helpers}
safe_auc <- function(y, p) {
  ok <- !is.na(p) & !is.na(y)
  if (sum(ok) < 2 || length(unique(y[ok])) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  tryCatch(as.numeric(pROC::auc(pROC::roc(y[ok], p[ok], quiet = TRUE))),
           error = function(e) NA_real_)
}

# Calibration intercept (calibration-in-the-large) and slope
safe_calibration <- function(y, p) {
  ok <- !is.na(y) & !is.na(p)
  y <- y[ok]; p <- p[ok]
  if (length(y) < 5 || length(unique(y)) < 2) return(c(intercept = NA_real_, slope = NA_real_))
  lp <- qlogis(pmin(pmax(p, 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6))
  slope     <- tryCatch(unname(coef(glm(y ~ lp, family = binomial()))[2]),
                        error = function(e) NA_real_)
  intercept <- tryCatch(unname(coef(glm(y ~ offset(lp), family = binomial()))[1]),
                        error = function(e) NA_real_)
  c(intercept = intercept, slope = slope)
}

```

```{r apparent-performance}
# Pooled predicted probability: mean across imputed datasets
pred_mat <- sapply(seq_len(M_IMP), function(i) {
  predict_penalized(mice::complete(imp2, action = i), final_coef_simplified)
})
pred_prob_pooled <- rowMeans(pred_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
actual <- as.numeric(as.character(mice::complete(imp2, action = 1)[[outcome_var]]))
stopifnot(!anyNA(pred_prob_pooled))

roc_obj <- pROC::roc(actual, pred_prob_pooled, quiet = TRUE, ci = TRUE)
auc_apparent <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_obj))
auc_ci_delong <- as.numeric(pROC::ci.auc(roc_obj))

# Youden-optimal threshold (first one if tied)
best_coords <- pROC::coords(roc_obj, "best", best.method = "youden",
                            ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity", "ppv", "npv"))
best_coords <- lapply(as.list(as.data.frame(best_coords)), function(v) as.numeric(v[1]))

# Calibration
cal_apparent           <- safe_calibration(actual, pred_prob_pooled)
cal_intercept_apparent <- cal_apparent["intercept"]
cal_slope_apparent     <- cal_apparent["slope"]

# Full model (all candidate variables), for comparison only
pred_prob_pooled_full <- rowMeans(sapply(seq_len(M_IMP), function(i) {
  predict_penalized(mice::complete(imp2, action = i), final_coef)
}), na.rm = TRUE)
auc_apparent_full <- safe_auc(actual, pred_prob_pooled_full)

cat(sprintf("Apparent AUC %.3f (95%% CI %.3f-%.3f)\n",
            auc_apparent, auc_ci_delong[1], auc_ci_delong[3]))
```

# Bootstrap internal validation

```{r bootstrap-setup}
# Full model-building pipeline applied to one bootstrap sample
fit_lasso_pipeline_boot <- function(dat_raw, m_boot, maxit_boot, seed_i) {
  meth_b <- mice::make.method(dat_raw); meth_b[outcome_var] <- ""
  pred_b <- mice::make.predictorMatrix(dat_raw)
  imp_b  <- mice::mice(dat_raw, m = m_boot, method = meth_b, predictorMatrix = pred_b,
                       maxit = maxit_boot, seed = seed_i, printFlag = FALSE)
  imp2_b <- mice::as.mids(add_log_volume(mice::complete(imp_b, action = "long", include = TRUE)))

  coefs <- vector("list", m_boot)
  for (i in seq_len(m_boot)) {
    xy <- build_xy(mice::complete(imp2_b, action = i))
    set.seed(seed_i * 1000 + i)
    cvf <- tryCatch(glmnet::cv.glmnet(xy$X, xy$y, family = "binomial", alpha = 1, nfolds = NFOLDS_CV),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(cvf)) next
    coefs[[i]] <- as.matrix(coef(cvf, s = "lambda.min"))[, 1]
  }
  coefs <- coefs[!sapply(coefs, is.null)]
  if (length(coefs) != m_boot) return(NULL) # retain only complete bootstrap pipelines

  terms_b <- Reduce(union, lapply(coefs, names))
  cm <- do.call(cbind, lapply(coefs, function(v) v[terms_b]))
  cm <- as.matrix(cm)
  rownames(cm) <- terms_b
  coef_avg_b      <- rowMeans(cm, na.rm = TRUE)
  coef_avg_b_full <- coef_avg_b

  # Same variable-retention rule as the main analysis, applied within the bootstrap sample
  base_b <- sapply(terms_b, term_to_base, vars = lasso_vars_use)
  var_freq_b <- sapply(lasso_vars_use, function(v) {
    terms_v <- terms_b[!is.na(base_b) & base_b == v]
    if (length(terms_v) == 0) return(0)
    mean(apply(cm[terms_v, , drop = FALSE] != 0, 2, any, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE)
  })
  keep_vars_b  <- names(var_freq_b)[var_freq_b >= SELECT_FREQ_THRESHOLD]
  keep_terms_b <- c("(Intercept)", terms_b[base_b %in% keep_vars_b])
  coef_avg_b[setdiff(names(coef_avg_b), keep_terms_b)] <- 0

  list(coef = coef_avg_b, coef_full = coef_avg_b_full, imp = imp2_b)
}

# LOWESS calibration curve evaluated on a fixed grid (no extrapolation)
smooth_calibration_at <- function(y, p, xout, f = 2/3) {
  ok <- is.finite(y) & is.finite(p)
  y <- as.numeric(y[ok]); p <- as.numeric(p[ok])
  if (length(y) < 20 || length(unique(y)) < 2 || length(unique(p)) < 5)
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(xout)))
  ord <- order(p)
  sm <- tryCatch(stats::lowess(p[ord], y[ord], f = f, iter = 0), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(sm) || length(unique(sm$x)) < 2) return(rep(NA_real_, length(xout)))
  pmin(pmax(stats::approx(sm$x, sm$y, xout = xout, ties = mean, rule = 1)$y, 0), 1)
}

cal_pred <- pred_prob_pooled
cal_xmax <- min(1, max(0.40, ceiling(as.numeric(quantile(cal_pred, 0.99)) / 0.05) * 0.05))
cal_grid <- seq(0, cal_xmax, length.out = 81)
cal_curve_apparent <- smooth_calibration_at(actual, cal_pred, cal_grid)
```

```{r bootstrap-run}
optimism_vec           <- rep(NA_real_, B)
optimism_vec_full      <- rep(NA_real_, B)
auc_boot_apparent_vec  <- rep(NA_real_, B)
slope_optimism_vec     <- rep(NA_real_, B)
intercept_optimism_vec <- rep(NA_real_, B)
cal_curve_optimism_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = B, ncol = length(cal_grid))

pooled_pred <- function(imp_obj, m, coef_vec) {
  rowMeans(sapply(seq_len(m), function(i) {
    predict_penalized(mice::complete(imp_obj, action = i), coef_vec)
  }), na.rm = TRUE)
}

t0 <- Sys.time()
set.seed(SEED)

for (b in seq_len(B)) {
  idx_b    <- sample(seq_len(nrow(df_impute)), replace = TRUE)
  boot_raw <- df_impute[idx_b, ]

  fitb <- fit_lasso_pipeline_boot(boot_raw, m_boot = M_BOOT, maxit_boot = MAXIT_BOOT,
                                  seed_i = 1000 + b)
  if (is.null(fitb)) next

  actual_boot <- as.numeric(as.character(boot_raw[[outcome_var]]))

  # Final (retained-variable) model: bootstrap sample and original sample
  pred_boot <- pooled_pred(fitb$imp, fitb$imp$m, fitb$coef)
  pred_orig <- pooled_pred(imp2, M_IMP, fitb$coef)

  auc_boot_apparent <- safe_auc(actual_boot, pred_boot)
  optimism_vec[b]          <- auc_boot_apparent - safe_auc(actual, pred_orig)
  auc_boot_apparent_vec[b] <- auc_boot_apparent

  cal_boot <- safe_calibration(actual_boot, pred_boot)
  cal_test <- safe_calibration(actual, pred_orig)
  slope_optimism_vec[b]     <- cal_boot["slope"] - cal_test["slope"]
  intercept_optimism_vec[b] <- cal_boot["intercept"] - cal_test["intercept"]

  cal_curve_optimism_mat[b, ] <- smooth_calibration_at(actual_boot, pred_boot, cal_grid) -
                                 smooth_calibration_at(actual, pred_orig, cal_grid)


  # Full model (all candidate variables), for comparison only
  optimism_vec_full[b] <- safe_auc(actual_boot, pooled_pred(fitb$imp, fitb$imp$m, fitb$coef_full)) -
                          safe_auc(actual, pooled_pred(imp2, M_IMP, fitb$coef_full))

  if (b %% 20 == 0) cat(sprintf("Bootstrap %d / %d\n", b, B))
}

cat(sprintf("Elapsed: %.1f min; valid resamples (AUC): %d / %d\n",
            as.numeric(Sys.time() - t0, units = "mins"), sum(is.finite(optimism_vec)), B))
```

```{r optimism-correction}
if (sum(is.finite(optimism_vec)) < 2) stop("Insufficient valid bootstrap resamples to calculate corrected AUC")
mean_optimism <- mean(optimism_vec, na.rm = TRUE)
auc_corrected <- auc_apparent - mean_optimism

# Location-shifted bootstrap 95% CI (Noma et al., Stat Med 2021)
auc_boot_ok      <- auc_boot_apparent_vec[is.finite(auc_boot_apparent_vec) & is.finite(optimism_vec)]
auc_corrected_ci <- pmin(pmax(quantile(auc_boot_ok, c(0.025, 0.975), names = FALSE) -
                                mean_optimism, 0), 1)

auc_corrected_full <- auc_apparent_full - mean(optimism_vec_full, na.rm = TRUE)

cal_intercept_corrected <- cal_intercept_apparent - mean(intercept_optimism_vec, na.rm = TRUE)
cal_slope_corrected     <- cal_slope_apparent - mean(slope_optimism_vec, na.rm = TRUE)

# Optimism-corrected calibration curve
cal_curve_mean_optimism <- apply(cal_curve_optimism_mat, 2, function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
})
cal_curve_corrected <- pmin(pmax(cal_curve_apparent - cal_curve_mean_optimism, 0), 1)
cal_curve_corrected[colSums(is.finite(cal_curve_optimism_mat)) < max(20, ceiling(B * 0.5))] <- NA_real_
```

# Performance summary

```{r performance-summary}
f3 <- function(x) sprintf("%.3f", x)

performance_summary <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Patients / events",
    "Apparent AUC (95% CI, DeLong)",
    "Optimism-corrected AUC (95% CI, location-shifted bootstrap)",
    "AUC optimism",
    "Calibration intercept, apparent / corrected",
    "Calibration slope, apparent / corrected",
    "Youden threshold",
    "Sensitivity / specificity at Youden threshold",
    "PPV / NPV at Youden threshold",
    "Valid bootstrap resamples"
  ),
  Value = c(
    sprintf("%d / %d", length(actual), sum(actual == 1)),
    sprintf("%s (%s-%s)", f3(auc_apparent), f3(auc_ci_delong[1]), f3(auc_ci_delong[3])),
    sprintf("%s (%s-%s)", f3(auc_corrected), f3(auc_corrected_ci[1]), f3(auc_corrected_ci[2])),
    f3(mean_optimism),
    sprintf("%s / %s", f3(cal_intercept_apparent), f3(cal_intercept_corrected)),
    sprintf("%s / %s", f3(cal_slope_apparent), f3(cal_slope_corrected)),
    f3(best_coords$threshold),
    sprintf("%s / %s", f3(best_coords$sensitivity), f3(best_coords$specificity)),
    sprintf("%s / %s", f3(best_coords$ppv), f3(best_coords$npv)),
    sprintf("%d / %d", length(auc_boot_ok), B)
  )
)
write.csv(performance_summary, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "performance_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

performance_summary %>%
  kable(caption = "Final model performance") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "left")

data.frame(
  Model = c("Full model (all candidate variables)", "Final model (retained variables)"),
  Apparent_AUC  = f3(c(auc_apparent_full, auc_apparent)),
  Corrected_AUC = f3(c(auc_corrected_full, auc_corrected))
) %>%
  kable(caption = "Full versus final model") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "left")
```

```{r figure-settings}
fig_prefix <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, sprintf("%s_%d",
  if (PRIMARY_COHORT) "NodeNegative" else "AllPatients", length(actual)))

# Display labels for the nomogram (model terms are not changed)
DISPLAY <- list(
  histology_group = list(label = "Histologic subtype",
                         levels = c("EMG1", "EMG2", "EMG3", "Other high-grade")),
  molecular_subtype = list(label = "Molecular subtype",
                           levels = c("p53abn", "NSMP", "MSI-H", "POLEmut")),
  deep_myometrial_invasion  = list(label = "Deep myometrial invasion",
                                   levels = c("Absent", "Present")),
  cervical_stromal_invasion = list(label = "Cervical stromal invasion",
                                   levels = c("Absent", "Present")),
  extrauterine_extension    = list(label = "Extrauterine extension",
                                   levels = c("Absent", "Present")),
  radiologic_ln_enlargement = list(label = "Radiological LN enlargement",
                                   levels = c("Absent", "Present")),
  age   = list(label = "Age (years)"),
  bmi   = list(label = "BMI (kg/m²)"),
  ca125 = list(label = "CA-125 (U/mL)")
)
NOMOGRAM_TICKS <- list(bmi = c(20, 25, 30, 35, 40), ca125 = seq(0, 500, 100))
CA125_DISPLAY_MAX <- 500   # display only; the model uses CA-125 as a continuous variable
```

```{r nomogram, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=5.2}
dat_pub <- dat_for_nomo
for (v in intersect(names(DISPLAY), nomo_vars)) {
  if (!is.null(DISPLAY[[v]]$levels)) {
    stopifnot(nlevels(dat_pub[[v]]) == length(DISPLAY[[v]]$levels))
    levels(dat_pub[[v]]) <- DISPLAY[[v]]$levels   # order unchanged
  }
  Hmisc::label(dat_pub[[v]]) <- DISPLAY[[v]]$label
}

dd_pub <- rms::datadist(dat_pub)
options(datadist = "dd_pub")

fit_pub0 <- rms::lrm(as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", paste(nomo_vars, collapse = " + "))),
                     data = dat_pub, x = TRUE, y = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(coef(fit_pub0)) == length(coef(fit_nomo)))
fit_pub <- fit_pub0
fit_pub$coefficients <- setNames(unname(coef(fit_nomo)), names(coef(fit_pub0)))

# Relabelling must not change predictions
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(
  as.numeric(predict(fit_nomo, newdata = dat_for_nomo, type = "lp")),
  as.numeric(predict(fit_pub,  newdata = dat_pub,      type = "lp")),
  tolerance = 1e-8)))

# Range of the linear predictor over the displayed predictor ranges
display_ranges <- lapply(nomo_vars, function(v) {
  if (is.factor(dat_pub[[v]])) levels(dat_pub[[v]])
  else if (v == "ca125") c(0, CA125_DISPLAY_MAX)
  else range(dat_pub[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)
})
names(display_ranges) <- nomo_vars
extreme_grid <- do.call(expand.grid, c(display_ranges, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
for (v in nomo_vars) if (is.factor(dat_pub[[v]])) {
  extreme_grid[[v]] <- factor(extreme_grid[[v]], levels = levels(dat_pub[[v]]))
}
lp_extreme <- as.numeric(predict(fit_pub, newdata = extreme_grid, type = "lp"))
lp_min <- min(lp_extreme); lp_max <- max(lp_extreme)

probability_ticks <- c(.05, .08, .10, .15, .20, .25, .30, .35, .40, .45)
probability_ticks <- probability_ticks[probability_ticks >= plogis(lp_min) - 1e-10 &
                                       probability_ticks <= min(.45, plogis(lp_max)) + 1e-10]

nom_pub <- do.call(rms::nomogram, c(
  list(fit_pub, lp = FALSE, lp.at = seq(lp_min, lp_max, length.out = 201),
       fun = plogis, fun.at = probability_ticks, funlabel = "LNM probability",
       maxscale = 100),
  NOMOGRAM_TICKS[intersect(names(NOMOGRAM_TICKS), nomo_vars)]
))

# Total-points axis limited to attainable values
ni <- attr(nom_pub, "info")
tp_min <- (lp_min - ni$Intercept) * ni$sc
tp_max <- (lp_max - ni$Intercept) * ni$sc
tp_ticks <- pretty(c(max(0, tp_min), tp_max), n = 8)
tp_ticks <- tp_ticks[tp_ticks >= max(0, tp_min) - 1e-8 & tp_ticks <= tp_max + 1e-8]
if (tp_min <= 1e-8) tp_ticks <- sort(unique(c(0, tp_ticks)))
if (length(tp_ticks)) nom_pub[["total.points"]]$x <- tp_ticks

render_nomogram <- function() {
  par(mar = c(1.2, 1, 1, 1), family = "sans", mgp = c(2, .6, 0), las = 1)
  plot(nom_pub, xfrac = .30, cex.axis = .68, cex.var = .88, lmgp = .25)
}
ragg::agg_tiff(paste0(fig_prefix, "_Nomogram.tiff"), width = 7.5, height = 5.2,
               units = "in", res = FIG_DPI, compression = "lzw", background = "white")
render_nomogram(); invisible(dev.off())
grDevices::cairo_pdf(paste0(fig_prefix, "_Nomogram.pdf"), width = 7.5,
                     height = 5.2, family = "sans", bg = "white")
render_nomogram(); invisible(dev.off())
render_nomogram()

options(datadist = old_datadist)
```

```{r roc-calibration, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
pub_theme <- ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  ggplot2::theme(plot.title  = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
                 axis.title  = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11),
                 axis.text   = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10),
                 legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9),
                 plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(8, 10, 8, 8))

# (A) ROC curve
roc_df <- data.frame(fpr = 1 - rev(roc_obj$specificities),
                     sensitivity = rev(roc_obj$sensitivities))

p_roc <- ggplot2::ggplot(roc_df, ggplot2::aes(x = fpr, y = sensitivity)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.95) +
  ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.55) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.97, y = 0.06, hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 3.7, lineheight = 1.1,
    label = sprintf("Apparent AUC = %.3f (95%% CI %.3f–%.3f)\nCorrected AUC = %.3f (95%% CI %.3f–%.3f)",
                    auc_apparent, auc_ci_delong[1], auc_ci_delong[3],
                    auc_corrected, auc_corrected_ci[1], auc_corrected_ci[2])) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, .25), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, .25), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ggplot2::coord_fixed() +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "A", x = "1 − Specificity", y = "Sensitivity") +
  pub_theme

# (B) Calibration plot
cal_df <- rbind(
  data.frame(predicted = cal_grid, observed = cal_curve_apparent,  curve = "Apparent"),
  data.frame(predicted = cal_grid, observed = cal_curve_corrected, curve = "Bootstrap-corrected")
)
cal_df$curve <- factor(cal_df$curve, levels = c("Apparent", "Bootstrap-corrected"))

p_cal <- ggplot2::ggplot(cal_df, ggplot2::aes(x = predicted, y = observed, linetype = curve)) +
  ggplot2::geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.55) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE) +
  ggplot2::geom_rug(data = data.frame(predicted = cal_pred), ggplot2::aes(x = predicted),
                    inherit.aes = FALSE, sides = "b", alpha = 0.16, linewidth = 0.22) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = cal_xmax * 0.97, y = cal_xmax * 0.08, hjust = 1, vjust = 0,
    size = 3.7, lineheight = 1.2,
    label = sprintf("Corrected intercept = %.2f\nCorrected slope = %.2f",
                    cal_intercept_corrected, cal_slope_corrected)) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, cal_xmax), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, cal_xmax), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ggplot2::coord_fixed() +
  ggplot2::scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Apparent" = "dashed", "Bootstrap-corrected" = "solid")) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "B", x = "Predicted probability", y = "Observed probability", linetype = NULL) +
  pub_theme +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = c(0.34, 0.90),
                 legend.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))

combined <- p_roc + p_cal + patchwork::plot_layout(ncol = 2)
print(combined)

ggplot2::ggsave(paste0(fig_prefix, "_ROC_Calibration.tiff"), combined, width = 260, height = 130,
                units = "mm", dpi = FIG_DPI, compression = "lzw", bg = "white")
ggplot2::ggsave(paste0(fig_prefix, "_ROC_Calibration.pdf"), combined, width = 260, height = 130,
                units = "mm", device = grDevices::cairo_pdf)
```
